fields.description: Rosemont Residences is a small Ellington apartment development in Jumeirah Village Triangle, with one- and two-bedroom homes and shared pool, garden and family facilities.

sources.label: Ellington Rosemont Residences brochure and plans
Rosemont Residences branded project brief, broker mirror
Property Finder Rosemont Residences project guide

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Rosemont page and branded documents confirm apartment development, not unrelated same-name international projects.
reviewCoverage.location: Own body identifies Jumeirah Village Triangle; branded brief places it within District2. Existing JVT mapping used.
reviewCoverage.residences: One-/two-bedroom apartment mix, with nineteen and twenty-eight units in original guide. No studios or three-bedroom homes inferred.
reviewCoverage.areas: Own22-page brochure includes all five individual layouts on spreads19–21, visually read. Broker24-page brief repeats individual plans; no second source allocation counted separately for same information.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own named pool, fitness, garden, library, pet and children’s facilities used. Broader community cycling/jogging facilities not presented as private building amenities.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Portal exact1390828 launch reference distinguished from rounded1.4m, not used as current developer inventory claim.
reviewCoverage.payment: Actual guide page24 visually read:20+10+10+six5+30=100. Reservation-relative days and construction progress triggers kept distinct.
reviewCoverage.handover: Branded original forecastQ42025 and portalDecember2025 elapsed; own October 2026 gallery does not supply a completion certificate. Headline date null rather than falsely ready.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own22-page brochure with detailed plans and broker24-page full brief downloaded. Five actual plan/configuration/payment spreads visually read. Current dated gallery checked read-only.

overview: A smaller apartment collection pairs private outdoor space with shared leisure and pet-friendly facilities.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. Routes and journey times depend on traffic and the selected destination.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 1,390,828, rounded to AED 1.4 million. This launch guide is not a current selected-unit quotation or confirmation of available developer stock.
research.paymentNote: The staged table follows the original branded guide. Confirm current contract dates, remaining balances and charges separately.
research.handoverNote: The original guide anticipates Q4 2025 and Property Finder lists December 2025. Those elapsed forecasts do not establish actual delivery; the current developer gallery continues through October 2026.

facts.label: Original unit mix
facts.value: The guide lists 19 one-bedroom and 28 two-bedroom apartments. These 47 homes are project scale, not live inventory.

facts.label: Printed rounding
facts.value: Type B one-bedroom components total 812.67 ft²; the drawing prints 812.68 ft², retained here.

facts.label: Dated gallery
facts.value: An October 2026 developer construction gallery is available; its date alone does not establish handover.
